name: GAIB sAID
oneLiner: sAID is GAIB's staked AI Dollar vault: AID is deposited into an ERC-4626 vault tracking AI infrastructure financing NAV with a 30-day FIFO unstaking cycle.
collateral: AID staked into GAIB's ERC-4626 sAID vault; vault capital is deployed into AI infrastructure financings (GPUs, robotics, and related compute) plus a stable reserve buffer of T-bills and stablecoins for liquidity
pegMechanism: sAID is not pegged to $1; it is minted by staking AID at the staking NAV (which ignores unrealized losses, keeping the mint price stable) and redeemed through a monthly withdrawal-cohort cycle: requests submitted within a calendar month are aggregated, liquidity is sourced the following month, and funds settle on the first day of the third month at the unstaking NAV (which subtracts unrealized losses). Selling sAID on a supported DEX is the immediate-liquidity alternative.

mintAuthority.summary: sAID is GAIB's ERC-4626 strategy-vault wrapper over AID. Wrapper shares remain AID-backed with no privileged current-implementation mint path, but either a legacy DEFAULT_ADMIN EOA or an independent 3-of-5 DEFAULT_ADMIN Safe can replace the UUPS implementation immediately. Base issuance inherits the reviewed AID mint-authority profile.

controls.label: sAID ERC-4626 UUPS wrapper
controls.capDescription: asset() is AID 0x18f52b3fb465118731d9e0d276d4eb3599d57596. Public ERC-4626 mint and deposit remain asset-backed, with maxMint and maxDeposit returning uint256 maximum; the current implementation has no privileged share-mint path.
controls.evidence: At Ethereum block 25526129, asset() returned AID and the proxy's ERC-1967 implementation slot resolved to verified implementation 0xe2986b3e5b3e77896ae0509f6740d1106273374d; admin and beacon slots were zero. The implementation's public ERC-4626 mint and deposit paths transfer matching AID assets.

controls.label: sAID DEFAULT_ADMIN EOA (independent immediate upgrade path)
controls.evidence: The current implementation authorizes UUPS replacement for DEFAULT_ADMIN_ROLE. This EOA retained DEFAULT_ADMIN_ROLE through block 25526129, had no bytecode, and could successfully call upgradeTo with no timelock. It separately retained OPERATOR_ROLE and REWARDER_ROLE.

controls.label: sAID DEFAULT_ADMIN Safe (independent 3-of-5 upgrade path)
controls.evidence: This separate Safe retained DEFAULT_ADMIN_ROLE through block 25526129 and can replace the UUPS implementation without the EOA. At the cutoff it was Safe 1.4.1 with a 3-of-5 threshold, no enabled modules, and zero guard.

review.evidence: At Ethereum block 25526129, sAID used verified UUPS implementation 0xe2986b3e5b3e77896ae0509f6740d1106273374d with zero admin and beacon slots. The current implementation gates upgrades on DEFAULT_ADMIN_ROLE. EOA 0x3885be006eba7a7f5d555b4f78f237536700d1b1 and independent 3-of-5 Safe 0x32793f6b11820fa9c7039dfa640b751f491a027d both retained that role with no revocations or timelock.
